comment: The band is kidnapped by crooks, but escapes in Rock 'n' Roll fashion and is rewarded for nailing the bad-guys. For the money they arrange a huge concert in an orphanage.

The band plays on a giant stage. The crowd, the arena, the speakers, the lights - it's all gigantic. The crowd goes mental, stage-diving and shouting. In the end a score of people go up on stage to dance.

The band walks along a street, singing. More and more people join in and after a while the street is full of dancing people. Old friends who fought turn to kiss and make up, kids hug their parents, and diplomats sign a peace treaty.
The band goes for a spin in a big convertible. They laugh and play in the car, spraying each other with beer and standing on the seats. The girls look fantastic with their scarves and sunglasses.

The band is dressed up in hockey gear, waiting nervously on the ice when the other team comes on. They're a mean looking bunch and the crowd cheers. The band is mauled by the brutes, but in the end they win.

In the studio with the band, mixing a serious recording  closed eye lids concentrated guitar-playing type material  with playful shots of band members playing practical jokes on each other and the crew.

The band has shrunk. They're walking along the neck of a guitar, but they can't even reach the strings. They find a piano and strike the keys by jumping on them. As they play, they grow and by the end they're back to normal.

Setting: thirties Chicago, prohibition days. The band drives cars from the era and wears fishbone-tailored suits, carrying out the everyday business of gangsters: shooting, robbing and running from police.
The band is on an expedition in the jungle, dressed in khaki and wearing jungle hats. They meet all kinds of dangerous animals, but they all seem to like the music.
This video is full of wet asphalt, neon lights and high-speed footage of miles of road. Nothing really happens, but it looks cool.
There's a huge party at the band's house. People are everywhere: barbecuing, kissing in the pool, laughing, playing and dancing. The band plays on a stage in the garden.
